entity.name: Kaitlyn Brishae Truby
entity.description: Lead Systems Researcher and Principal Investigator (PI) of DDLSim-Lab. Specializing in bare-metal deterministic networking, kernel-level eBPF/XDP telemetry, microsecond latency profiling, and edge-cloud distributed computing architectures. Affiliated with the University of Arizona Global Campus (UAGC) and Lead Maintainer under Open Source Collective.

projects.name: DDLSim-Lab
projects.description: DDLSim-Lab is an open-source, bare-metal distributed simulation and deterministic benchmarking framework. Engineered to eliminate non-deterministic virtualization noise and hypervisor scheduling jitter, it provides microsecond-accurate network telemetry via native eBPF/XDP hooks, Linux Traffic Control (TC), and isolated kernel namespaces. Optimized for consensus protocols, distributed AI clusters, and cybersecurity resilience testbeds.
